paragraphs: Otto Environmental Systems sells containers and carts, and its product page groups them as residential waste and recycling carts and commercial waste containers. Commercial containers on that page are listed as front load and rear load units in yard sizes. Carts are described as available in multiple sizes, with services for assembly, delivery and recovery of residential roll-out containers.

The home page also offers reclamation of end-of-life plastic carts as an alternative to the landfill. Customization covers colors, graphics, features and shapes on original or stock products, and local representatives are offered for support during and after the sale. Financing of a purchase is offered.

Offices and manufacturing facilities are listed in North Carolina, Ohio, Michigan and Mexico. The about page describes lasting partnerships with businesses, corporations, municipalities and manufacturers. The home page points a resident of New York City to a separate site to see and order the NYC bins.
